idea-plugin.name: ASN.1
idea-plugin.description:
AI transparency notice: the code and documentation of this project were largely created with AI assistance (transparency notice pursuant to the EU AI Act).

Brings language support for ASN.1 (Abstract Syntax Notation One, ITU-T X.680) to the JetBrains IDE family.

File types

  • ASN.1 module files — .asn and .asn1 files are recognised and shown with a dedicated icon.

Language

  • Module definition — the module header including the object identifier and the encoding, tag and extension defaults is parsed; incomplete text is tolerated while typing.
  • Syntax highlighting — keywords, ::=, numbers, comments, braces, module name and object identifier arcs, with a color settings page.
  • Brace matching — { } and ( ).
  • Completion — the tag default EXPLICIT TAGS, IMPLICIT TAGS and AUTOMATIC TAGS, and the module keywords DEFINITIONS, BEGIN and END.
